reviews.title: Premium Build Quality with Flawless Back-Connect Support
reviews.comment: We build a lot of showcase PCs, and the JONSBO X400 in Gray has quickly become one of our top recommendations for a premium ATX chassis. If you are looking for a case that supports the new wave of back-connect motherboards (like BTF or Project Zero), this case executes it flawlessly, allowing for an incredibly clean, zero-cable aesthetic. The Technical Specs & Clearances: Motherboard Support: ATX, Micro-ATX, and Mini-ITX (Fully back-connect compatible). GPU Clearance: A massive 427mm. It will fit any RTX 4090 or 5090 on the market with plenty of room to breathe. Cooling Potential: Unbelievable airflow. It supports up to 13 x 120mm fans and can comfortably house 360mm AIO radiators on the top, bottom, or side. CPU Cooler & PSU: Fits CPU air coolers up to 176mm tall and ATX power supplies up to 180mm. Aside from the specs, we highly recommend this case for its build quality. Weighing in at over 22 lbs empty, the SPCC steel chassis feels incredibly rigid and durable, and the tempered glass panels mate together beautifully without any massive gaps. It’s a heavy-duty, premium canvas for high-end components. 5/5 stars!

reviews.title: Great 2 chamber PC case!
reviews.comment: A really well made 2 chamber PC case with plenty of room for cable management and airflow! The case can comfortably fit a 360 AIO either on the top side or on the rear side. It's very easy to take off panels to work on things or route cables. There is a hidden fan tray above the motherboard to install fans for cooling the VRMs. There is space under the case to install up to 3 fans for more air intake.
